champions.desc: has a time-of-day pattern; bets against the btc move, last 4 hours; bets against the btc move, last hour; slightly bets against the eth move, last 15 min; slightly bets against the market price drift, last 20 min. Mostly ignores the market price. Only when the market is calm. Needs 3.6¢ of edge to bet.
